scientific_question: Can one global graph-off prompt-conditioned unary head, trained directly from a source prompt view to independent held-out target-view instance membership, improve over its frozen analytic unary without target RGB at inference?

method.name: RegisteredEvidenceToUnaryV1
input_scope: source visible mass and labeled coverage
directional dispersion, amplitude uncertainty, observation evidence, and visibility purity
method.output: continuous primitive foreground probability plus confidence and abstention
inference_forbidden_inputs: benchmark query, mask, label, score, or metric
method.zero_initialization: the learned residual is initially exactly the frozen analytic unary
method.bounded_update: logit residual is max_delta_logit=4.0 times tanh(network output)
method.capacity: two-layer MLP, hidden width 32, shared globally

data_authority.dataset: ScanNet v2 official projected 2-D instance IDs
data_authority.permitted_label_use: loss and metrics for this nonbenchmark prompt-unary pilot only; labels may not enter the canonical field, factorized state, capability bank, typed context, or benchmark evaluation

frozen_example_construction.eligible_instance: official instance ID > 0, present with at least 32 pixels after nearest-neighbor resize to the exact 60x80 responsibility grid in at least four authority views
frozen_example_construction.instance_split: validation iff uint64(first_16_hex(SHA256('registered_evidence_to_unary_v1|scene0001_00|<instance_id>'))) mod 5 equals 0; all other eligible instances are training
frozen_example_construction.target_views: all other eligible authority views; source and target are always distinct
frozen_example_construction.full_mask_prompt: source positive is the official instance mask and source negative is its complement on exact-raster supported pixels
frozen_example_construction.scribble_prompt: deterministic 16 positive and 32 negative source pixels selected by SHA256 order from the full-mask positive and a 5-pixel exterior ring respectively
frozen_example_construction.prototype_rule: L2-normalized exact-source-mass weighted positive and negative capability means; margin is positive cosine minus negative cosine

optimization.loss: target supported-pixel class-balanced binary cross entropy plus 0.05 primitive residual L2 and 0.02 confidence calibration
optimization.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation instance-macro pixel AP; ties use lower validation BCE then earlier epoch

metrics.primary: held-out validation instance-macro supported-pixel average precision
comparators: direct registered observation with unobserved rows supplied by the same frozen analytic unary

promotion_rule: Promote only if validation instance-macro AP and fixed-0.5 IoU both improve, precision does not regress by more than 0.01, area ratio stays in [0.8,1.25], and no validation instance loses more than 0.05 AP. This one-scene pilot cannot establish cross-scene generalization.
stop_rules: If fewer than three eligible validation instances remain after the frozen split, report an underpowered pilot and do not change the split.
If source-to-held-out-target metrics do not improve, stop this V1 feature/head rather than testing graph completion.
Do not open NVOS, SPIn9, or LERF benchmark target metrics for this pilot.
